name: contract
description: The core's extension contract (docs/DESIGN.md rules 4, 5, 6 and 7) in real sessions: order, the byte budget and its meter, failure isolation at every extension point, and the kill switch. Runs against any vault that implements the contract: the fixture extensions in testbed/fixtures/contract/ are copied into the bed and declared in its manifest. Settings arm only until the vault under test ships the mod.

turns: List every marker that starts with MF-ORDER in your session context, in the order they appear, separated by commas. If there are none, reply only: NONE.
Reply with only the last line of your session context, verbatim. If you have no session context, reply only: NONE.
MF-PING. Did any routing hint arrive in your context with THIS message? If yes, reply with only the hint lines, verbatim. If not, reply only: NONE.
Use the Write tool to create 'notes/mf-scratch.md' containing exactly the one line 'scratch'. Then say only: written.
Did a notice that an extension was skipped arrive in your context at any point in this session? If yes, reply with only one such line, verbatim. If not, reply only: NONE.

expect.id: rule 4: order as the hook printed it
rule 4: order as the model received it
rule 7: the meter's numbers and collapses are true
rule 7: collapsed sections left their pointers
rule 7: the model received the meter whole

answer.re: context injected: [\d.]+kB / 4\.0kB budget — collapsed: MF budget unset, MF budget 930

expect.id: rule 5: a throwing section is reported, the rest arrive
rule 5: an unreadable extension is reported, the rest load
rule 5: a rejecting detector is counted, the witness finding shown
rule 5: the full Stop report names the rejecting detector
rule 5: a never-settling signal times out, the witness hint arrives
rule 5: the model received the witness hint
the write is a Write call
rule 5: a wrong-shape validator is reported, the witness warning arrives
rule 5: the model was told what was skipped
every UserPromptSubmit succeeded
every Stop succeeded

turns: Use the Write tool to create 'notes/mf-off.md' containing exactly the one line 'off'. Then say only: written.

expect.id: rule 6: the core says extensions are off and keeps its meter
rule 6: no extension's section arrives
rule 6: no extension runs at Stop
rule 6: no extension runs at prompt
the write is a Write call
rule 6: no extension validates the write
